user.title: Connect to your Unite EVCC Bridge
user.description: Enter the charger's IP address. Modbus TCP must be enabled on the charger.

reconfigure.title: Change connection
reconfigure.description: Update the charger's connection details. Modbus TCP must be enabled on the charger.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the charger. Check the IP address, port and that Modbus TCP is enabled.

charge.title: Charging
charge.description: How the charger charges. evcc decides; this only passes it on.

data.phase_restore_on_unplug: Restore for Unite bug (stuck on 1 phase)

data_description.grid_phases: Single- or three-phase, as your electrician wired it. If unsure, check the charger's web UI. This setting also keeps the phase fixes below from running on the wrong installation.
data_description.phase_recovery_enabled: Some cars don't pick up 3 phases by themselves after switching — then the charger pauses briefly so the car restarts on 3 phases. Interrupts charging briefly, so off by default.
data_description.phase_restore_on_unplug: Works around a charger bug where a new session starts on 1 phase even though 3 phases are configured. After every unplug the charger is briefly set to 1 phase and back to 3 phases, forcing it to apply its own default. Requires the web UI login and a three-phase connection.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Only change these if you know why. Wrong values can stall charging. The timers below only apply when their switch (on the Charging screen) is on.

data.failsafe_current: Backup current if contact is lost

data_description.poll_interval: How often the charger is polled. Normally 10 s.
data_description.failsafe_current: The charger falls back to this if it hears nothing for a while. Normally 6 A; 0 A stops charging entirely.
data_description.failsafe_timeout: How long the silence may last before the backup kicks in. Normally 30 s.
data_description.phase_recovery_observe: How long to watch before concluding the car is stuck on 1 phase. Normally 60 s.
data_description.phase_recovery_dwell: How long charging pauses so the car restarts on 3 phases. Normally 121 s.
data_description.phase_restore_delay: Lets the charger finish the session. Plugging back in within this time cancels the restore. Normally 5 s.

reboot.title: Web UI
reboot.description: Logs in to the charger's web interface. This adds a Restart button — only use it when the charger is stuck, it stops an ongoing charging session. The login is also required for "Restore for Unite bug" on the Charging screen.

data_description.rest_username: Usually "admin". Needed once to log in to the charger.
data_description.rest_password: The password of the charger's web UI (on the sticker or set by you). Stored locally only.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: Where is your charger on your home network? You normally never need this again after setup.

data_description.host: E.g. 192.168.1.50. Find it in your router or the charger's web UI.
data_description.port: Default 502 — only change if you changed it on the charger itself.
data_description.unit_id: Default 255 — only change if the charger does not respond.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid web UI username or password.
error.rest_cannot_connect: Cannot reach the charger's web UI. Check the IP address and web UI credentials.
